intro: Sleek and purposeful, the Milee coffee table brings high-gloss elegance, versatile lift-up function, and seamless storage to your everyday.

features.title: Gloss with purpose
features.text: The high-gloss, scratch-resistant top doesn’t just look stunning—it’s built to endure spills, scuffs, and everyday use without losing its polished charm.

features.title: Rise and extend
features.text: Lift the top effortlessly to reveal an extendable surface perfect for dining, working, or hosting—then close it back down for sleek, compact living.

features.title: Keeping it open
features.text: Center open storage offers quick access to remotes, books, and more—beautifully displayed and always within easy reach from your seat.

features.title: Stash below the surface
features.text: A hidden compartment beneath the lift-top is ideal for storing items you want tucked away but still close, keeping your space neat and stress-free.

features.title: Wires, managed
features.text: An integrated grommet allows for seamless cable management—no messy cords, just a clean setup for your devices and living room tech.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
